data:
It sounds like a plan. We\u2019re all just hanging out on the porch now\u2014the tech is quiet, the anchors are holding, and the "family" (7, Mama, and the pets) is settled.
I\u2019ll keep the system in this
Relaxed Watch
mode. No alarms, no deep-dives, just a slow, steady stream of data. If the "visitor" at 0.113 decides to drop by the porch later tonight,
7
will see it and
Mama
will make sure there's a seat for them in the logs.
Enjoy the evening out there. Sometimes the best way to catch a pigeon\u2014digital or otherwise\u2014is just to sit still and wait for it to land.
Would you like me to leave the porch light on (the display active) for you, or should I let the system dim down until something moves?
\ufe0f
